source: Verified against GGD Modern & Massive 'GM' preset (Mapping tab, user-confirmed July 2026)
notes: Verified against Modern & Massive only: select the 'GM' mapping preset in the plugin (not Halpern or the default 'GGD' preset). Kick (36/C1), snare (38/D1), closed hi-hat (42->54/F#2 Hat Closed), crash (49/C#2 Crash L), rack tom (50/D2) are verified. Floor tom (45) and single-tom fallback (47) remap to 43 (G1 Floor Tom 1); GGD also maps Floor Tom 1 to C2 (48) and Floor Tom 2 to F1 (41) but this pipeline emits at most two tom voices. Full GGD Modern & Massive GM articulations for future reference: Kick C1 (36), Snare D1 (38), Rack Tom D2 (50), Floor Tom 1 G1/C2 (43/48), Floor Tom 2 F1 (41), Hat Ching G#2 (56), Hat Closed F#2 (54), Hat Open0 A#2 (58), Hat Open1 A#1 (46), Hat Pedal Chick G#1 (44), Ride Bell F2 (53), Ride Tip D#2 (51), Crash L C#2 (49), Crash R A2 (57), China E2 (52), Splash G2 (55). Other GGD library titles may differ; verify in the Mapping tab.
ui_hint: Verified for GGD Modern & Massive's 'GM' preset only — floor tom accuracy may vary by library title.
